$comment: KRYLO environment (security) profiles. The active profile is selected through plugin userConfig key security_profile. Markdown intent: docs/10-data-egress.md.

local-only.description: No external code context, no external MCP servers, no production access, local-only telemetry.

private-approved.description: External access limited to approved providers; official or reviewed integrations only; production read-only when explicitly configured.

public-repository.description: External code context allowed when relevant; official and reviewed integrations allowed; no automatic production access.

production-read-only.description: Allowlisted integrations only, read-only credentials, no external writes, no secret retrieval.
